sp.speaker: Men
sp.l: The mother slain, wilt thou add blood to blood?

sp.speaker: Ores
sp.l: T' avenge my father; yet betray'd by thee.

sp.speaker: Men
sp.l: Art thou not sated with thy mother's blood?

sp.speaker: Ores
sp.l: Never, with punishing such impious women.
VOL. 11.

sp.speaker: Men
sp.l: And art thou, Pylades, accomplice with him ?

sp.speaker: Ores
sp.l: His silence speaks : sufficient my reply.

sp.speaker: Men
sp.l: But short thy joy, unless thou fly on wings.

sp.speaker: Ores
sp.l: We will not fly: but we will fire the house.

sp.speaker: Men
sp.l: Thy father's royal seat in ruins sink!

sp.speaker: Ores
sp.l: That it may ne'er be thine: and at the flames
Her will I sacrifice.

sp.speaker: Men
sp.l: Ay, kill her; do;
I will have vengeance, ample vengeance on thee.

sp.speaker: Ores
sp.l: Thus then.

sp.speaker: Men
sp.l: Ah, stay thee: do not, do not kill her!

sp.speaker: Ores
sp.l: Be silent now, and with composure bear
Th' afflictions, which with justice light on thee.

sp.speaker: Men
sp.l: What, is it justice then that thou shou'dst live ?

sp.speaker: Ores
sp.l: Live! Ay, and reign.

sp.speaker: Men
sp.l: Where wou'dst thou reign?

sp.speaker: Ores
sp.l: In Argos,
Pelasgian Argos.

sp.speaker: Men
sp.l: At the sacred rites
Well would those hands the cleansing lavers touch.

sp.speaker: Ores
sp.l: And wherefore not?

sp.speaker: Men
sp.l: And, e'er the spear is rais'd
Offer the hallow'd victim!
Dost not thou ?
And well: my hands are pure.

sp.speaker: Ores
sp.l: But not thy heart.

sp.speaker: Men
sp.l: Who will hold converse with thee?

sp.speaker: Ores
sp.l: He that loves
His father.

sp.speaker: Men
sp.l: He too, who reveres his mother!

sp.speaker: Orés
sp.l: Happy his state.

sp.speaker: Men
sp.l: Unhappy then is thine.

sp.speaker: Ores
sp.l: Because such impious women I abhor.

sp.speaker: Men
sp.l: Take, from my daughter's bosom take thy sword.

sp.speaker: Ores
sp.l: False are thy words.

sp.speaker: Men
sp.l: My daughter wilt thou kill?

sp.speaker: Ores
sp.l: Now thou speak'st truth.

sp.speaker: Men
sp.l: Ah me, what shall I do?

sp.speaker: Ores
sp.l: Go to the Argives, and persuade them-

sp.speaker: Men
sp.l: Shall I persuade them?

sp.speaker: Ores
sp.l: Ask the state to spare
Our lives.
Or you will kill my daughter?

sp.speaker: Men
sp.l: Unhappy Helen!

sp.speaker: Ores
sp.l: Am not I unhappy?

sp.speaker: Men
sp.l: From Troy I brought thee to be butcher'd here.
Ay.

sp.speaker: Ores
sp.l: Would it were so!

sp.speaker: Men
sp.l: After a thousand toils

sp.speaker: Ores
sp.l: But not for me.

sp.speaker: Men
sp.l: These dreadful ills fall on me.
Thou hast caught me.

sp.speaker: Ores
sp.l: Thou hadst no will to serve me.
No: by thy baseness thou hast caught thy self.
But go, Electra, fire the house below:
And thou, my Pylades, my faithful friend,
Set from these battlements the roof on fire.

sp.speaker: Men
sp.l: Arm, arm, ye sons of Greece; ye warlike Argives,
Fly to my aid. Despair of life, and guilt
Stain'd with his mother's blood prompt his bold hand
In one wide ruin to involve the city.

sp.speaker: Apollo
sp.l: Cease, Menelaus, forbear this fiery rage:
Apollo speaks: revere the present god.
And thou, Orestes, whose uplifted sword
Threatens that virgin's life, forbear, and hear.
Her, whom thy rage, to work him woe, assail'd,
This radiant form in tissued clouds inshrin'd,
Snatch'd from thy sword I sav'd; such the command
Of heav'n's high king: his beauteous progeny
Soars above mortal fate, and orb'd in heav'n
Immortal 'midst her kindred stars she shines,
Beaming kind influence on the mariners.
Lead to thy royal house another wife;
Since by her beauty the just gods awoke
'Twixt Greece and Troy the rage of war, to free
The groaning earth from impious multitudes.
Such is the fate of Helen. Thou, Orestes,
Quitting this country, in Parrhasia's plains
For one revolving year thy dwelling fix,
And give the place thy name; that honour share
With Azan and with Arcas. Pass from thence
To Athens; there against the Furies urge
Thy plea, acquit thee of thy mother's blood :
There in that awful court the gods shall sit
Thy judges; and thy just cause shall prevail.
Her, at whose throat thy angry sword was pointed,
The gods decree thy wife; though Pyrrhus dreams
Of nuptial joys, the Delphic sword awaits him;
My vengeance on Achilles this demands.
To Pylades thy sister is betroth'd;
Give him his bride: and happiness attends
To pour her blessings on their future years.
Thou, Menelaus, yield that Orestes reign
At Argos: haste to Sparta, reign thou there,
And wear that crown, the dow'ry of thy wife,
The well-earn'd meed of all the toils she caus'd thee.
It shall be mine t' appease the state to him,
Compell'd by my command to slay his mother.

sp.speaker: Ores
sp.l: Thou god of oracles, prophet of good,
True are thy words, and faithful. Yet my soul
Was struck with horror, lest some vengeful pow'r
Spoke this, which I misdeem'd thy voice divine.
But all is well. Obedient to thy word
I drop the sword; and, if her father gives her,
Wish to receive Hermione my bride.

sp.speaker: Men
sp.l: Daughter of Jove, bright Helen, hail! thy state
'Midst the blest mansions of th' immortal gods
1 reverence. Now, Orestes, give I thee
My daughter, at the bidding of the god.
Illustrious in thy race thou takest a wife
Not less illustrious: blessings on thy hand
That takes her, and on mine that gives her to thee.

sp.speaker: Apol
sp.l: Each now depart, as I commanded: cease

sp.speaker: Ores
sp.l: Your strife.
T' obey is ours.
Such are my thoughts.
Now, Menelaus, to all these evils past
My soul speaks peace; and to thy oracles.

sp.speaker: Apol
sp.l: Go then your ways, now go, and reverence Peace,
Most beauteous of the gods. I will conduct
Th' immortal Helen to the house of Jove
O'er yon star-spangled sky, to the bright seats
Where, with majestic Juno, and the bloom
Of Hebe ever young, Alcides' joy,
A goddess she shall hear the vows of mortals;
And honour'd with the twin-born sons of Jove
Guide the tost mariners, and rule the sea.

sp.speaker: Chor
sp.l: O Victory, I revere thy sober triumphs :
Thus ever guard, thus ever crown my life!
